description: In the fixed ambient model universe, the executable universal test accepts an actual quantifier-free matrix exactly when its actual universal closure is true in every nonempty structure.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.QuantifierFreeValidity.universalTest_correct.{u, v, a} {L : FirstOrder.Language}
  {α : Type a} [DecidableEq α] [(n : ℕ) → DecidableEq (L.Functions n)] [(n : ℕ) → DecidableEq (L.Relations n)]
  (A : L.Formula α) (hA : FirstOrder.Language.BoundedFormula.IsQF A) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.QuantifierFreeValidity.universalTest A = true ↔
    ∀ (M : Type (max u a)) (inst : L.Structure M),
      Nonempty M → M ⊨ Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.QuantifierFreeValidity.universalClosure A
